dialogues.speaker: Elmi
dialogues.text: How did I even end up here...

dialogues.speaker: Elmi
dialogues.text: I can't deny it. I lost a bet with Taye, so I had to accompany her here.

dialogues.speaker: Elmi
dialogues.text: We were both assigned to The Dewdrop bar... but it turns out there are two bars with that name — one in the east, one in the west.

dialogues.speaker: Elmi
dialogues.text: I can't deny it. We're just like the evening sun and moon. One in the east, the other in the west.
